blocks.caption: Chapter 6 key terms
rows: Data science
Collecting, organising, analysing and interpreting data to find useful information and support decisions
Structured / unstructured data
Data in a fixed format such as tables / data without one, such as images, videos, emails and audio files
Machine learning
A branch of artificial intelligence in which computers learn patterns from data to predict or decide
Supervised / unsupervised / reinforcement learning
Learning from labelled data / finding hidden groups without labels / learning from rewards and penalties
Feature and target value
An input the model uses, such as study hours / the output it predicts, such as an exam score
Train-test split
Dividing data into training data and testing data
Predictive model
A model that uses past data to estimate future values or outcomes
Model evaluation
Checking performance with accuracy, error, precision, recall and F1-score
Parameter tuning
Adjusting model settings to improve performance
Prediction / causality
Estimating a future value from past data / explaining cause-and-effect relationships
Machine learning tools
Software used to analyse data and build models, such as Excel, R, Python and Jupyter Notebook
